nota_simple.upload_unavailable: Upload feature available in next version
nota_simple.encumbrance_disclaimer: This action plan is an AI-generated informational guide and does not replace advice from a lawyer or notary
nota_simple.judicial_buyer_action: Request a copy of the court order from the seller and verify if the lien is cancelled or active. Do not sign until you have a cancellation certificate.
nota_simple.judicial_seller_action: Provide court documentation certifying the status of the proceedings. If the lien is active, it must be cancelled from the sale proceeds.
nota_simple.financiera_buyer_action: Negotiate subrogation or request prior cancellation by the seller before the notarial act. Request the outstanding debt certificate from the bank.
nota_simple.financiera_seller_action: Coordinate with your bank for the registry cancellation of the mortgage, either by payment or buyer subrogation.
nota_simple.administrativa_buyer_action: Verify the scope of the administrative charge with the relevant authority before formalising the purchase.
nota_simple.administrativa_seller_action: Clarify with the authority whether the charge is transferable or must be cancelled before the sale.

smart_bid_risk.title: Offer Risk Analysis
smart_bid_risk.label_low: Offer at or above asking price
smart_bid_risk.label_low_detail: Your offer is at or above the asking price. The statistical probability of acceptance is high.
smart_bid_risk.label_medium_detail: Your offer is slightly below the asking price. This is common in negotiations and may result in a counter-offer.
smart_bid_risk.label_medium_high_detail: Your offer is below the asking price within a negotiable range. The seller may respond with a counter-offer.
smart_bid_risk.label_high_detail: Your offer is well below the asking price. The statistical probability of direct rejection is high.
smart_bid_risk.no_historical_data: Insufficient historical data for this area. The analysis is based solely on the current price differential.
smart_bid_risk.statistical_disclaimer: Risk is statistical, not a prediction of human behaviour. Insufficient historical data.
